pages.error: ERRORED_DOCUMENT_REQUEST: Lighthouse was unable to reliably load the page (Status code: 403)

findings.title: The main content loads slowly (Largest Contentful Paint)
findings.fix: Make the largest element (usually the hero image or headline) load first: preload it, compress it, and cut render-blocking CSS and JavaScript.

findings.title: Lighthouse performance score is under 50
findings.fix: Work through the slow-loading findings above, starting with the largest savings.

findings.title: Images are larger than they need to be
findings.fix: Serve images as WebP or AVIF at the size they are shown, and lazy-load those below the fold.

findings.title: CSS and JavaScript delay the first paint
findings.fix: Inline the critical CSS, and load the rest of the CSS and scripts with defer or async.

findings.title: The server takes over 600 ms to send the page
findings.fix: Cache the HTML at a CDN, or speed up the server work behind these pages.

findings.title: JavaScript blocks the page from responding (Total Blocking Time)
findings.fix: Split, defer or remove JavaScript that runs on load, third-party scripts first.

findings.title: Pages load JavaScript they do not use
findings.fix: Remove unused libraries and split the bundle so each page loads only its own code.
